# Word VBA numeric authoring continuation

## Implementation checkpoint

This continuation adds shared source-known `Abs`, `Int`, `Fix` and `Sgn`
calculations to the Word, Excel and PowerPoint VBA adapters. No native operation,
renderer, document format or tracked dependency manifest changes are needed.
The exact [numeric contract](../../VBA_MACROS.md#numeric-intrinsics) distinguishes
negative floor/truncation, Empty/Null behavior, explicit conversion requirements
and the existing portable numeric envelope from full VBA numeric subtype rules.

The executable
[Word numeric report](../../../packages/quds_office_engine/example/macros/word_numeric_report.bas)
requires three body paragraphs and one independent primary-header paragraph.
It emits nine ordinary native operations through typed helpers and computed
selectors, preserves unrelated rich text and inert VBA project bytes, and keeps
the existing validation, recording, rollback and permission boundaries.

The first remote implementation checkpoint is
`f3e93e7ba7a847f6e90ed7afbf8b618ddee19867`. Its focused compiler and canonical
corpus suites pass 192 cases. The completed DOCX/DOCM/CLI/MCP integration suite
passes another 12 cases. The actual BAS produces identical VM/JavaScript
receipts. These development results will be superseded by the final source-bound
regression and portability qualification below; they are not added twice.

## Preserved intake

The initial captured frontier contains 45 fork heads, all 339 pull-request heads
and four original upstream heads. Both outstanding Zotero continuations are
incorporated with real merge ancestry. Their production fixes were already in
initial main `aa861c28e336b17bcd4c259351164380cd6b1438`; the intake adds their
separate qualification evidence and both page-cache regression test files.
The one documentation conflict retains both independently scoped narratives.

Remote intake checkpoint `80cc132f57367a9cfe607ed6c510e3175a24e17c` preserves
`c0ae75c226b13ae1ec4ab31238004d558ad01531` and
`a7f69313ed2e610f82242c31be8ad5387ae5cea0` as parents. Its replay accounts for
all 388 captured refs: **374 actual ancestors and 14 verified historical
replacements**, with no uncovered refs. Thirteen replacements have identical
complete Git trees; one has identical blob/mode changes on every touched path. See
[the intake record](intake/README.md), exact inventory, proofs and replay script.

## Local qualification procedure

Use the pinned Dart 3.13.7 and the existing dependency lock. Resolve the normal
workspace with its pinned Flutter SDK, or reproduce the isolated pure-Dart
engine harness described in `independent/README-runtime-and-numeric-review.md`.
The harness creates only an ignored package config and keeps all tracked
manifests/locks unchanged. No GitHub Actions/check/status queue is queried.

```sh
python3 docs/validation/word-vba-numeric-20261121/run_local.py \
  --dart /path/to/dart-sdk/bin/dart --phase regression --output /path/to/results/regression
python3 docs/validation/word-vba-numeric-20261121/run_local.py \
  --dart /path/to/dart-sdk/bin/dart --phase static --output /path/to/results/static
python3 docs/validation/word-vba-numeric-20261121/run_local.py \
  --dart /path/to/dart-sdk/bin/dart --phase portable --output /path/to/results/portable
```

The runner retains process exits, compressed raw stdout/stderr, case identities,
source snapshots before/after, SDK/package-config identities and complete native
receipts. The portability phase uses the exact BAS and fixture bytes, checks
VM/JavaScript equality, and includes the existing Variant composition/conversion
corpora because numeric functions compose with nullable expressions.

The independent numeric review separately passes 81 checks on both VM and
JavaScript, with identical receipts and unchanged compiler source. It covers
negative zero, subnormals, both numeric bounds, static refusals, single helper
evaluation and typed alias identity. Those supplemental checks are retained
separately from regression totals.

## Scope

This is bounded source-to-native-plan compatibility. It does not add document
reads, embedded VBA execution, locale-dependent implicit coercions, complete
VBA numeric subtype fidelity or an installed Microsoft Word differential run.
The inherited renderer tests are preserved; this source-only change does not
claim a new Flutter/UI or installed Office qualification.

# Zotero research-table margins and native ODT padding

This increment aligns native table layout with the uniform `cellMargin` already
stored in the Word model and DOCX. It extends editable Zotero ODT import/export
to preserve the same bounded padding, including nested and merged table owners.

## Remote intake

Work started from `aa861c28e336b17bcd4c259351164380cd6b1438`. All fork branches,
pull-request heads and upstream branches/PR heads were fetched before new code.
The outstanding Zotero continuations `c0ae75c226b13ae1ec4ab31238004d558ad01531`
and `a7f69313ed2e610f82242c31be8ad5387ae5cea0` were integrated, preserving both
sets of cache regressions and the separately attributed qualification records.
Their README conflict was resolved by retaining both records.

The combined tree was saved remotely as
`57c5729ab1aa1ea8c1e27a4c76b233060b843e11`. `intake-initial.json` captures the
exact ref snapshot; `verify_intake.py` rechecks ancestry and independently proves
the fourteen historical equivalents using exact Git trees or changed-path
mode/type/blob equality. Historical test counts retain their original source
attribution and are not fresh acceptance of this increment.

## Implementation contract

- Native measurement, text wrapping, row height, pagination and ruler fallback
  use each table's actual uniform margin. The existing model default remains
  4 pt; the old fixed 4.25 pt rendering inset is corrected.
- Nested tables retain independent margins. Picture height limits account for
  the sum of ancestor margins, including temporary tall-row engines and notes.
- Explicit editable Zotero ODT writes `fo:padding` on cell styles. The ordinary
  cached-result ODT path retains its existing formatting contract.
- Native ODT import resolves family defaults and named parent chains. A layer's
  shorthand resets its four sides; that layer's side attributes then override
  it. Only equal effective sides and a uniform margin across visible owners of
  one table are represented. Nested tables resolve separately.
- Covered-cell authored padding must agree with its merged owner. Positive
  borders, asymmetric or per-cell margins, unsupported row/column defaults,
  invalid lengths, exhausted cell widths and margins beyond native DOCX storage
  remain explicit refusals. LibreOffice's `border="none"` declarations are inert
  and accepted.

## Qualification

Fresh local and external-converter results are recorded by the completion
checkpoint. GitHub Actions are not the acceptance path and are neither queried
nor awaited. Installed Zotero-plugin sessions, Microsoft Word application
acceptance, supported-release LibreOffice testing and legacy Apache OpenOffice
compatibility remain separate from deterministic tests and the available
LibreOffice development-build file converter.

Active footnote separator geometry remains the next dedicated note-formatting
increment. It needs model, pagination, rendering and DOCX/ODT conversion work;
admitting its XML alone would not preserve the document faithfully.

## Primary format references

- [ODF 1.3 Part 3](https://docs.oasis-open.org/office/OpenDocument/v1.3/os/part3-schema/OpenDocument-v1.3-os-part3-schema.html),
  table styles, covered cells and padding attributes.
- [XSL 1.0 section 5.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xsl-20011015/slice5.html#refine-shorthand),
  shorthand expansion and explicit-property precedence.

## Why

Actual LibreOffice-saved Zotero documents passed metadata inventories but failed native Quds reopening or changed table/note formatting on later saves. This increment qualifies editable native round trips against the authored source model.

## Changes

- Reopen supported bibliography TextSections with inherited inert section styles, rich and empty entries, exact ownership, and preserved unknown metadata.
- Qualify LibreOffice decimal note offsets against visible labels. Emit separate symbol/anchor styles per note class and preserve the compatible final endnote page master; validate effective formatting on import.
- Preserve fixed table widths/alignment through LibreOffice and complete uniform cell margins through DOCX, including zero and bounded style inheritance. Keep unsupported imported margin XML sparse.
- Recompute optional soft-page hints while preserving authored hard breaks. Retain protection, malformed input, unsupported formatting and ownership guards.

## Local qualification

- **1,913 engine tests /81 suites**, **139 editor tests /9 suites**, **26 Studio tests /3 suites**: **2,078 passes, zero failures or skips**.
- Formatting, fatal-info analysis and whitespace checks pass.
- Three fixtures /11 active fields pass two actual LibreOffice saves with native reopen, DOCX save/reopen and editable ODT reexport between them. Exact metadata, text, editability, offsets, ownership, rich styles, table geometry and note/page formatting are checked.
- A separate mixed-note export check preserves seven inventories and all four note style roles; it does not claim native footnote reopening.
- Twelve independent source-binding checks connect executed inputs to checkpoint d743c1b3. The later main canvas change is explicitly separated from the unchanged engine/converter inputs and has fresh editor/Studio checks.

## Integration and limits

All375 initial refs are covered by361 ancestors and14 independently verified historical equivalents. Incoming main through3440c90b is merged. Later concurrent work is explicitly recorded in the final intake instead of being represented as merged.
